extractor.note: Read every paragraph carrying transcend- (outside transcendental) or immanen-, in file order. No stratum is set: the commentary does not tie these sections to the 1912, 1915, Stein, Landgrebe or later strata.

coverage_note: Term-led pass over the whole file (lines 1-1213): every paragraph containing the transcendence family, including bare transcendent and immanent, was read; paragraphs without such a word were not read.

units.claim: Nature is initially determined as the field of transcendent realities, specifically spatiotemporal realities.
units.quote: He recalls the initial determination that nature is the field of transcendent realities, specifically spatiotemporal realities.

units.claim: Pure egos are given originally and in absolute selfhood in immanent phenomenological time, without constitution through manifolds, whereas real egos and all realities stand in reverse.
units.quote: in the sphere of immanent phenomenological time, neither capable of nor requiring constitution through “manifolds” — with the real egos and all realities things stand in reverse

units.claim: The psychic ego is not the monadic flux nor a real moment of it but a unity essentially referred to it yet in a certain sense transcendent to it.
units.quote: but rather a unity essentially referred to it yet in a certain sense transcendent to it

units.claim: Phenomenological reflection and reduction, with eidetic reduction and the purging of all transcending apperceptions, turn the inquiry into a pure one.
units.quote: with eidetic reduction and the purging of all transcending apperceptions, turn the whole inquiry into a pure one

units.claim: Each of my experiences, as constituent of the objective spatiotemporal world, is not directly experienceable, since the form of intersubjective objectivity is no immanent form.
units.quote: since the form of reality, that of intersubjective objectivity, is no immanent form

units.claim: Thing-appearances are not states of the subject, as is clear from their being transcendent to the subject's actual experiences.
units.quote: that they are not states of the subject is clear from their being transcendent to the subject's actual states, its experiences

units.claim: Objective and subjective time, my immanent and my spatio-temporal, are a priori a single temporal order.
units.quote: a priori objective time and subjective time — my immanent and my spatio-temporal — are a single temporal order

units.claim: Acts such as I push or I dance are also a cogito, but one that includes a transcendence-thesis within it.
units.quote: One can say that the "I push," "I dance" and the like is also a cogito, only one that includes a transcendence-thesis in itself and harbors the "ego sum" within this mixed form.

units.claim: In the structure of thing-constituting consciousness all nature with space, time and causality is dissolved into a web of immanent motivations.
units.quote: we see that all nature with space, time, causality and the rest is completely dissolved into a web of immanent motivations

units.claim: Once the physical substrate is physicalized, body and soul too receive a physically determined transcendence.
units.quote: This holds at first only for the physical substrate, but as soon as it becomes physical, body and soul too receive a physically determined transcendence.

absences.expected_because: The analysis of things, spatial phantoms and sensation data falls within nature, which §1 determined as the field of transcendent realities.
